source_admission: Published values used as constants, quoted ranges or cited findings; no external dataset files are admitted. 'access' records how far each source was checked: a literature-gathering agent fetched and read each one (or, for the TIA standard, its clause text) and quoted it; nothing was re-read here. Model products of this repository are cited by path in the README and hashed in the results.
